entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sordland One's flight from Holsord..."
entries.dialogueText: Sordland One's flight from Holsord to Staalport took three hours but went very smoothly. We were about to touch down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Deivid left his seat and came over..."
entries.dialogueText: Deivid left his seat and came over while Symon was enjoying his newspaper.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Looks like we are about to land, M..."
entries.dialogueText: “Looks like we are about to land, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked outside. I could see Helji..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked outside. I could see Heljiland, the island in between Valgsland and Agnolia.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“So many conflicts over such a smal..."
entries.dialogueText: “So many conflicts over such a small piece of land. The island can barely sustain itself without outside help.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't blame them. It is in a ver..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't blame them. It is in a very strategic position.”
entries.menuText: “I don't blame them. It is in a very strategic position.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I know. I was just thinking the sa..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know. I was just thinking the same thing.”
entries.menuText: “I know. I was just thinking the same thing.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“If I was in the shoes of the Agnol..."
entries.dialogueText: “If I was in the shoes of the Agnolian Prime Minister, I would do anything to protect the motherland.”
entries.menuText: “If I was in the shoes of the Agnolian Prime Minister, I would do anything to protect the motherland.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Thousands of people died fighting..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thousands of people died fighting for it. I wonder if it was worth it.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Of course. But as I get older, I s..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course. But as I get older, I started to question more things.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Certainly. If you have Heljiland,..."
entries.dialogueText: “Certainly. If you have Heljiland, you are in control of the whole Valgos Channel.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“I suspect it will be one of the to..."
entries.dialogueText: “I suspect it will be one of the topics that Mr. Van Hoorten will bring up as a bargaining chip. We must be careful.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Heljiland might be under the contr..."
entries.dialogueText: “Heljiland might be under the control of Agnolia, but the international community has yet to recognise it. For a good reason, too.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Nobody wants to make an enemy of V..."
entries.dialogueText: “Nobody wants to make an enemy of Valgsland. Especially because of the support of United Contana and the CSP.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Me included. I wouldn't want do an..."
entries.dialogueText: “Me included. I wouldn't want do anything to injure our relationship with Valgsland.”
entries.menuText: “Me included. I wouldn't want do anything to injure our relationship with Valgsland.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't care who we're up against...."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't care who we're up against. We will cross that bridge when we come to it.”
entries.menuText: “I don't care who we're up against. We will cross that bridge when we come to it.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Aside from the point of Heljiland,..."
entries.dialogueText: “Aside from the point of Heljiland, we need to be careful with the additional requests.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“We should try to look at the bigge..."
entries.dialogueText: “We should try to look at the bigger picture.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“I agree. We should try our best to..."
entries.dialogueText: “I agree. We should try our best to stick to the middle ground.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Symon folded his newspaper, got up..."
entries.dialogueText: Symon folded his newspaper, got up from his seat and sat right next to us.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“According to the deal that was neg..."
entries.dialogueText: “According to the deal that was negotiated so far, they want to sell us their steel for a higher price and they are requesting easier access to our agricultural market.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“In return, they are promising cash..."
entries.dialogueText: “In return, they are promising cash flow and investments, especially in the Agnland region. It's not hard to guess why.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“During the initial negotiations, t..."
entries.dialogueText: “During the initial negotiations, they brought up the topic of immigration many times.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“The fact that we have relaxed our..."
entries.dialogueText: “The fact that we have relaxed our immigration laws will help tremendously.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Our job will be harder because of..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our job will be harder because of our new tightened immigration laws.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Let's see if we can shake hands on..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's see if we can shake hands on it.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The pilot made an announcement that..."
entries.dialogueText: The pilot made an announcement that the descent had started. Deivid and Symon went back to their seats.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took another look outside the win..."
entries.dialogueText: I took another look outside the window. I could see Staalport, the capital city of Agnolia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The large dockyards of the city and..."
entries.dialogueText: The large dockyards of the city and the canals -- "Staal" in Agnolian -- appeared closer as our descent continued. Staalport was certainly a fitting name.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A couple of minutes later, we final..."
entries.dialogueText: A couple of minutes later, we finally touched down. The plane parked. I took a final look out the window. The welcoming ceremony from Agnolia was waiting along the red carpet outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After the guards made their way out..."
entries.dialogueText: After the guards made their way out, I exited the plane.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I waved at the crowd that gathered...."
entries.dialogueText: I waved at the crowd that gathered. There were many camera flashes. I started to make my way downstairs.
entries.menuText: Wave at the crowd.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I started to make my way downstairs..."
entries.dialogueText: I started to make my way downstairs. There were many camera flashes.
entries.menuText: Proceed without a gesture.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Prime Minister Van Hoorten was nowh..."
entries.dialogueText: Prime Minister Van Hoorten was nowhere in sight. Instead, I was greeted by the Foreign Minister.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After handshakes and a couple of ph..."
entries.dialogueText: After handshakes and a couple of photos, I moved to the car where Serge was waiting to drive me to the office of Prime Minister.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Good day, sir. I hope the flight w..."
entries.dialogueText: “Good day, sir. I hope the flight was comfortable.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's go.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's go.”
entries.menuText: “Let's go.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes, it was. Thank you, Serge.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, it was. Thank you, Serge.”
entries.menuText: “Yes, it was. Thank you, Serge.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I nodded."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded.
entries.menuText: Nod.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I got in the car and we made our wa..."
entries.dialogueText: I got in the car and we made our way through the foreign streets. Our convoy was protected by Sordish and Agnolian guards in their vehicles.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We got on the highway beside the po..."
entries.dialogueText: We got on the highway beside the port and saw dozens of dockyards and ships anchored. Some of the boats and machinery looked old.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The city itself looked very grey an..."
entries.dialogueText: The city itself looked very grey and grim. The buildings had a touch of Rumburg's famous Monarkian architecture with a mixture of Sordish signature domes on the older ones.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We were now on the main road to the..."
entries.dialogueText: We were now on the main road to the office of the Prime Minister.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Looks like they are not too happy..."
entries.dialogueText: “Looks like they are not too happy to see you, sir.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge pointed at the crowd that gat..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge pointed at the crowd that gathered on both sides of the street. It was a protest. They were shouting and yelling at our convoy. Some of them held signs written in Sordish: 'Go Home Rayne', 'We Don't Want Autocrats In Agnolia.'

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“You know... I never knew Agnolians..."
entries.dialogueText: “You know... I never knew Agnolians were so ungrateful. Not everyone sees a great leader like you everyday.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They can yell all they want.”"
entries.dialogueText: “They can yell all they want.”
entries.menuText: “They can yell all they want.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You are absolutely right, Serge. S..."
entries.dialogueText: “You are absolutely right, Serge. So ungrateful.”
entries.menuText: “You are absolutely right, Serge. So ungrateful.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“There have been so many issues in..."
entries.dialogueText: “There have been so many issues in Sordland. I don't know if I can call myself a great leader.”
entries.menuText: “There have been so many issues in Sordland. I don't know if I can call myself a great leader.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""I know what it is. They were alway..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know what it is. They were always scared of Sordland's potential. And now they are afraid that a lion leads Sordland. They are afraid of you."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Sir, humility is important but not..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sir, humility is important but not in this case. They were always scared of Sordland's potential. And now they are afraid that a lion leads Sordland. They are afraid of you.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Not just that, but you are a man w..."
entries.dialogueText: “Not just that, but you are a man who is selfless enough to help your driver's children.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“A true leader, I dare say.”"
entries.dialogueText: “A true leader, I dare say.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Don't mention it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Don't mention it.”
entries.menuText: “Don't mention it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“How is little Anton doing?”"
entries.dialogueText: “How is little Anton doing?”
entries.menuText: “How is little Anton doing?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I treat my people well.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I treat my people well.”
entries.menuText: “I treat my people well.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“He is fine, sir. A strong boy. Tak..."
entries.dialogueText: “He is fine, sir. A strong boy. Takes after his namesake for sure!”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“I can attest to that myself. I am..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can attest to that myself. I am honored to be your driver. And very grateful.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Very well, sir. I just want to say..."
entries.dialogueText: “Very well, sir. I just want to say that I am honored to be your driver. And very grateful.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“We have arrived, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We have arrived, sir.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The convoy started slowing down."
entries.dialogueText: The convoy started slowing down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The car continued through the gates..."
entries.dialogueText: The car continued through the gates while the security vehicles went the other way. We finally came to a stop in front of the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge left the car and opened the c..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge left the car and opened the car door. I exited and began walking to the door where dozens of press and the Prime Minister were waiting for me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw the PM much more clearly as I..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw the PM much more clearly as I neared the door. He was shorter than I thought.

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“Mr. President. Welcome to Agnolia..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. Welcome to Agnolia and to the beautiful city of Staalport.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you so much for the warm wel..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you so much for the warm welcome. It is great to be here.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you so much for the warm welcome. It is great to be here.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Prime Minister.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Prime Minister.”
entries.menuText: “Prime Minister.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good to see you, Maartin.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good to see you, Maartin.”
entries.menuText: “Good to see you, Maartin.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He reached out for a handshake. The..."
entries.dialogueText: He reached out for a handshake. The press surrounding us had been waiting for this moment.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I overpowered his handshake and he..."
entries.dialogueText: I overpowered his handshake and he got caught by surprise as the press took the picture of me having the upper hand. He smiled awkwardly.
entries.menuText: Overpower his handshake.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "We shook hands and smiled at the ca..."
entries.dialogueText: We shook hands and smiled at the cameras as the press took pictures.
entries.menuText: Shake hands.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "We shook hands and I went for a hug..."
entries.dialogueText: We shook hands and I went for a hug which was received well by the Prime Minister. The press went wild and took more pictures.
entries.menuText: Shake hands and hug after.

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“This way, please.”"
entries.dialogueText: “This way, please.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured to the entrance of the..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured to the entrance of the two-hundred-year old Parliament building.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We entered and the press followed u..."
entries.dialogueText: We entered and the press followed us inside.

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“I would like to present you with a..."
entries.dialogueText: “I would like to present you with a gift as a sign of friendship between our countries.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An assistant showed up immediately..."
entries.dialogueText: An assistant showed up immediately with a large glass case in her hands. It contained a single sheet of parchment inside.

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“This here is one of the first trea..."
entries.dialogueText: “This here is one of the first treaties written between Sordland and Agnolia. May it mark the renewal of our friendship today as well!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I hope so, Mr. Van Hoorten.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I hope so, Mr. Van Hoorten.”
entries.menuText: “I hope so, Mr. Van Hoorten.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This is an amazing gift. Thank you..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is an amazing gift. Thank you.”
entries.menuText: “This is an amazing gift. Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very good.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very good.”
entries.menuText: “Very good.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our photos were taken again. I gest..."
entries.dialogueText: Our photos were taken again. I gestured at one of my retainers who was holding our gift to the PM.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Our gift was a Sordish-bred puppy,..."
entries.dialogueText: Our gift was a Sordish-bred puppy, despite Maartin's known fear of dogs.
entries.menuText: Gift a Sordish-bred puppy despite Maartin's known fear of dogs.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Our gift was one of the original co..."
entries.dialogueText: Our gift was one of the original copies of the first constitution of Sordland.
entries.menuText: Gift one of the original copies of the first constitution of Sordland.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Our gift was an ornamented ceremoni..."
entries.dialogueText: Our gift was an ornamented ceremonial sword made with Sordish steel.
entries.menuText: Gift an ornamented ceremonial sword made with Sordish steel.

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“Ah! An excellent copy. I have alwa..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ah! An excellent copy. I have always wondered what one of the originals looked like. Thank you for this excellent gift.”

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“Ah! An excellent specimen. This mu..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ah! An excellent specimen. This must be hundreds of years old. It looks like this is Sordish steel as well. Very fitting. Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Maartin stepped backwards when the..."
entries.dialogueText: Maartin stepped backwards when the puppy howled. He very uncomfortably held the dog in his hands and tried to smile at the reporters before putting the dog down on the floor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The cameras flashed once again."
entries.dialogueText: The cameras flashed once again.

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“Let's go to my office. Follow me.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's go to my office. Follow me.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I followed him and we entered the o..."
entries.dialogueText: I followed him and we entered the office of the Prime Minister. With its minimalist wooden decor, the room was far more modest than I expected.

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“Sheesh. I'm thankful to be done wi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sheesh. I'm thankful to be done with the ceremonies.”

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“Would you like a drink, Mr. Rayne?..."
entries.dialogueText: “Would you like a drink, Mr. Rayne?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are you not fond of these ceremoni..."
entries.dialogueText: “Are you not fond of these ceremonies?”
entries.menuText: “Are you not fond of these ceremonies?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I was just about to say the same...."
entries.dialogueText: “I was just about to say the same. I'm not fond of these either.”
entries.menuText: “I was just about to say the same. I'm not fond of these either.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We sat down. He leaned back and mad..."
entries.dialogueText: We sat down. He leaned back and made himself comfortable.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I nodded."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded.
entries.menuText: Nod.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He got up from his chair and moved..."
entries.dialogueText: He got up from his chair and moved over to the bar. There were many varieties of liquor.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will have an Erlory Maroon 30-ye..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will have an Erlory Maroon 30-year-old.”
entries.menuText: “I will have an Erlory Maroon 30-year-old.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I wouldn't mind some Agnolian vodk..."
entries.dialogueText: “I wouldn't mind some Agnolian vodka.”
entries.menuText: “I wouldn't mind some Agnolian vodka.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Just water is fine.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Just water is fine.”
entries.menuText: “Just water is fine.”

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“Ah, you know your drink!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Ah, you know your drink!”

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“Ah, you're keeping it Sordish. A v..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ah, you're keeping it Sordish. A very good whiskey for sure.”

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“As you wish.”"
entries.dialogueText: “As you wish.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He poured the drinks and gave mine..."
entries.dialogueText: He poured the drinks and gave mine to me before sitting down again.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What was with that protest outside..."
entries.dialogueText: “What was with that protest outside? Can't you control them?”
entries.menuText: “What was with that protest outside? Can't you control them?”

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“Lashing out at me before we even s..."
entries.dialogueText: “Lashing out at me before we even start discussing the trade deal? Please look at your own country first before indulging yourself with Agnolian matters, Mr. Rayne.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's go straight to business.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's go straight to business.”
entries.menuText: “Let's go straight to business.”

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“Let's.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's.”

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“First of all, if we shake hands on..."
entries.dialogueText: “First of all, if we shake hands on it, this agreement is going to be extremely beneficial for both of us.”

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“You should be able to solve your r..."
entries.dialogueText: “You should be able to solve your recession in no time with the investment and money flow coming from us. This is, as you know, on top of the reduced tariffs for trade between our countries.”

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“Of course in return, as discussed..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course in return, as discussed between my people and your people before, you will allow us privileged access to your agricultural market.”

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“First of all, I would like to say..."
entries.dialogueText: “First of all, I would like to say that I have been watching your recent immigration policy changes. I am glad that you have decided to keep it relaxed.”

entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“First of all, I would like to say..."
entries.dialogueText: “First of all, I would like to say that I have been watching your recent immigration policy changes. We have worries about the new and tighter immigration laws.”

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“Immigrants are very important for..."
entries.dialogueText: “Immigrants are very important for beneficial economical development. We believe that very much in Agnolia.”

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“Immigrants are very important for..."
entries.dialogueText: “Immigrants are very important for beneficial economical development. We believe that very much in Agnolia.”

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten: "“I would definitely prefer Sordland..."
entries.dialogueText: “I would definitely prefer Sordland to be welcoming to Agnolian citizens and vice versa.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Before I start caring about Agnoli..."
entries.dialogueText: “Before I start caring about Agnolian citizens, I must care about my own people.”
entries.menuText: “Before I start caring about Agnolian citizens, I must care about my own people.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The decision has already been made..."
entries.dialogueText: “The decision has already been made.”
entries.menuText: “The decision has already been made.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Why don't you deal with the proble..."
entries.dialogueText: “Why don't you deal with the problems in your own country first?”
